Ticket Id: 24716

Dr Jeremy Barnett,

Emergency Registrar

Maroubra Hospital

Lakes Road

Maroubra

1/6/2011

Dear Dr. Barnett,

RE: Mr. John Elvin                         DOB: 1963

Thank you for seeing Mr. Elvin, a 48- year old patient whose features are suggestive of anterior AMI and
asthma exacerbation.

Mr. Elvin has a medical history of bronchial asthma and infrequent chest pain during exertion. He is on
regular medications of Seretide and salbutamol puffs. Moreover, he is smoker and alcohol dependent, but     Commented [JG1]: a
not interested in changing.

On 5/5/2011, Mr. Elvin was provisionally diagnosed as early stage of IHD. One week later, he was still      Commented [JG2]: with
complaining of chest pain on exertion and asthma progression related to upper airway inflammation. Mild
wheeze and mild ischemic changes were detected. The patient commenced Lipitor for high cholesterol,         Commented [JG3]: was
nitrates, aspirin and arginine.                                                                             Commented [JG4]: on

On 26/5/2011, the patient presented with the same manifestations as he was not compliant to the
medications. I notified him about the value of anti- asthma preventive medications. I also advised him to
have a reminder for all his medications, and to use salbutamol until asthma subsides.

Today, Mr. Elvin was presented with suspected anterior AMI and acute exacerbation of bronchial asthma.
The initial management was commenced including oxygen mask, GTN patch, morphine, ibratropium                Commented [JG5]: ipratropium
bromide neubilizer and frusemide.                                                                           Commented [JG6]: nebulizer

In view of the above, I am referring this patient for further management.

For any queries, please contact me

Yours sincerely,

Doctor
